text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e f-a-k-e r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s u-s-i-n-g d-i-s-c-a-r-d e-m-a-i-l a-d-d-r-e-s-s-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-e-h-i-n-d r-e-g-i-s-t-r-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d s-i-x d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h t-h-e f-a-k-e n-e-t-w-o-r-k, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-i-n-g f-a-l-s-e p-e-e-r r-e-v-i-e-w r-e-p-o-r-t-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-e d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-a-r-g-e-t-e-d a c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s m-a-n-u-s-c-r-i-p-t f-o-r r-e-j-e-c-t-i-o-n, p-r-o-d-u-c-i-n-g b-i-a-s-e-d a-d-v-e-r-s-a-r-i-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w c-o-m-m-e-n-t-s a-s a-n a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t o-f i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r h-i-d-d-e o-w-n a-f-f-i-l-i-a-t-i-o-n d-e-t-a-i-l-s f-r-o-m r-e-v-i-e-w e-n-v-e-l-o-p-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-u-b-j-e-c-t-m-a-t-t-e-r m-a-t-c-h-i-n-g r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e e-d-i-t-o-r i-a l-o-o-d c-h-e-c-k.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-s t-o s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-y, c-r-e-a-t-i-n-g a-l-t-e-r-e-d a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l e-n-t-r-y-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e m-a-n-u-s-c-r-i-p-t o-r-i-g-i-n v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
